post.description:
Validates the supplied client credentials and returns a JWT access token for authenticating subsequent requests to the Predoc Partner API.

Provide `client_id` and `secret_key` in the request body. If the credentials are valid, the JWT is returned in the `access_token` field.

### Using the token

Include the token in the `Authorization` header for subsequent requests:

```http
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

### Token expiration

Access tokens are valid for 5 minutes and should be refreshed before they expire.

post.description:
Creates a clinical-summary document request for the specified patient.

Use the returned `patientSummaryRequestId` with `GET /documents/{documentId}` to check processing status and retrieve the completed document.

Source documents are selected only by the requested categories and date range. The organization’s document-set delivery mode does not filter clinical-summary source documents.

Partner-facing display text is returned without literal `|` separators, while identifiers, patient keys, URLs, source metadata, codes, statuses, dates, timestamps, and contact fields are preserved as received.

Curated Data availability depends on your Predoc contract. Use this endpoint when structured clinical data is included in your workflow; otherwise, use the document endpoints to retrieve patient records in their original formats. Contact your account manager if you are unsure which endpoints are enabled for your organization.
